_comment: Rules for a character's first name and surname, checked when a character is created (backend/character_names.py, mirrored for the creation form in app/lib/characterNames.ts). An allow-list: Latin letters (a-z, A-Z, with accents and umlauts, plus extraLetters) and one separator between two letters. Everything else is refused - other alphabets, digits, punctuation, double quotes, slashes, brackets, < >, $, _, @, emoji, tabs, line breaks and invisible characters - because names reach stories, messages and other players, so nothing in a name may be readable as markup or code. A name is stored NFKC-normalised (wide or bold letter styles become plain letters), with each "replace" key swapped for its value, trimmed and with runs of spaces collapsed to one.
_accentsComment: Accents are combining marks U+0300-U+036F (except the invisible U+034F) on a letter, counted after splitting accented letters apart (NFD): é and ü are one accent each, ễ is two; extraLetters such as ø or ß are letters, not accents. At most maxAccentsInFullName in the whole name - first name and surname together (and so each one alone).
_maxInFullNameComment: The most of each sign a whole name may hold - first name and surname together (and so each one alone).

reservedWords._comment: Refused as a whole word or phrase of a name, in any letter case, and when the whole name with its separators removed spells one ("R un" is "run"). commands: every SugarCube 2 macro and child-tag name plus the Wudlands <<area>> macro (tests/test_character_names.py checks it against the bundled story format); staff: words that would let a name pose as the game or its staff.

_reservedAnywhereComment: Refused anywhere in a name once its separators are removed ("Wud Landsson").

examples._comment: Checked by tests/test_character_names.py against the backend rule (and once by hand against the form's copy).

fullNames._comment: [first name, surname, the two together as shown] - each name is checked on its own and the pair as the text "first surname".
